title: [CI] Make vcpkg binary cache actually restore; cache vcpkg tools and registry

review.body_prefix:
### Review assessment

The accumulated assessment found no remaining actionable defect in the vcpkg cache change. The baseline pins package selection, and restoring the registry object store still accelerates incremental fetching. The suggested cache refresh was not supported by a demonstrated correctness issue or measured aging regression, so it is not requested.

**Validation scope:** The pinned YAML and extracted PowerShell cache-key script passed structural parsing. Product compilation and a live CI cache-aging/performance experiment were not performed; no additional performance benefit is claimed.

No additional code change is requested by this assessment. This is a qualified review summary, not an unconditional approval.

actions.label: Post qualified assessment summary (no code changes requested)
